summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue bonds for School Facilities Improvement District No. 3, repaid by property taxes within that district.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes $129 million in school-improvement bonds repaid through a property-tax increase.
tax.quote: A “YES” vote is a vote in favor of authorizing the Merced Union High School District to issue and sell up to $129,000,000 in general obligation bonds to be secured by a property tax increase on lands located within School Facilities Improvement District No. 3.

schools.text: A Yes vote funds facility improvements in the district areas serving El Capitan, Merced, and Golden Valley high schools.
schools.quote: This proposed measure would authorize the District to issue and sell bonds in the amount of up to $129,000,000 for facilities improvements within Improvement District No. 3 which covers the District’s El Capitan, Merced, and Golden Valley High School Areas.

tax.text: The Measure Z opposition rejects the school bond because it would be funded by taxpayers.
tax.quote: Authorizes costly bond funded by taxpayer dollars despite massive levels of wasteful spending and awarding contracts without fair and open competition.
